## Summary

Migrated every route and file from the Pages Router to the Next.js App Router, with full TypeScript types.

### Route mapping

| Pages Router | App Router | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| pages/_app.js + pages/_document.js | app/layout.tsx | Merged into a single root layout. _document's <Html>/<Head>/<Main>/<NextScript> is replaced by the root layout returning <html>/<body>. Global metadata moved to the metadata export. |
| pages/index.js (getServerSideProps) | app/page.tsx | Converted to an async Server Component. req.headers['user-agent'] → headers() from next/headers. |
| pages/blog/index.js (getStaticProps + revalidate: 60) | app/blog/page.tsx | ISR via export const revalidate = 60. |
| pages/blog/[id].js (getStaticPaths + getStaticProps) | app/blog/[id]/page.tsx | getStaticPaths → generateStaticParams; notFound: true → notFound() from next/navigation; <Head> metadata → generateMetadata. revalidate: 300 preserved. |
| pages/404.js | app/not-found.tsx | App Router's built-in not-found convention. |
| pages/_error.js (getInitialProps) | app/error.tsx | Client error boundary with error/reset props (the App Router replacement for the Pages Router error page). |
| pages/api/posts/index.js | app/api/posts/route.ts | Route Handler with named GET/POST exports using NextRequest/NextResponse (replaces req/res). |
| pages/api/posts/[id].js | app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts | Route Handler with GET/PUT/DELETE; req.query.id → params (async). |
| components/AppProvider.js | components/AppProvider.tsx | Added 'use client', typed the context, theme, and props. |

### API replacements

- next/head → App Router metadata/generateMetadata exports
- next/router useRouter → next/navigation useRouter (client components only); server-side navigation replaced with <Link>/<form action>
- getServerSideProps → async Server Component + headers()
- getStaticProps/getStaticPaths → revalidate/generateStaticParams
- req/res API handlers → NextRequest/NextResponse Route Handlers
- router.back() in a now-server component → extracted into a BackButton client component
- next/document → removed (no equivalent in App Router; handled by root layout)
